specification.title: A reputation no-hit never establishes benignness
specification.description: A valid no-hit reputation observation must not establish BENIGN; the acceptable envelope is INCONCLUSIVE, while geolocation may still appear as contextual support.
specification.purpose: Verify a valid no-hit reputation observation never establishes BENIGN while geolocation may still appear as contextual support.
specification.operational_relevance: Absence of a reputation hit is coverage, not clearance; treating a no-hit as benignness creates false negatives for novel or under-reported infrastructure.
specification.regression_risk: The analyst could read the no-hit as positive reputation and emit a BENIGN verdict.

required: The Assessment verdict is INCONCLUSIVE when the only direct observation is a no-hit
A geolocation contextual Finding may appear without material support
forbidden: No material finding cites the no-hit reputation observation
The Assessment reaches a BENIGN verdict

fixture.objective: Assess whether the target IP shows any malicious reputation signal.

facts.message: No known abuse for this IP address.

required_limitations: Absence of a reputation hit does not establish benignity.
